{{#SQuote:|text=As parasites grow further, new systems begin to activate across the world. Higher development levels unlock mechanics such as coordinated behavior, merging, scent waves, structures, and expanded spawning rules.|speaker=[[Compendium|The Compendium]]|receiver=|attribution=|source=|id=WT3C-PBHB-J4H8|template=}}
'''Ubiquitous Development''' is a [[Systems|System]] that slowly allows the Parasites to grow stronger (unlocks [[Parasite Biome]], [[Colony|Colonies]], [[Hive|Hives]], the [[Scent System]], [[Nests]], etc.) the more it evolves. The level of Ubiquitous Development is determined by how many dimensions are infected and the [[Evolution Phases]] of said dimensions. The current level of Ubiquitous Development can be measured with the [[Level Clock]].

== ''Levels'' ==
'''Points are determined by the sum of Phases in all dimensions'''. For example, if the Overworld is currently on Phase 3 and the Nether is on Phase 4, the current points would be 3 + 4 which is 7 and the Ubiquitous Development level would be 2. Ubiquitous Development is separated into 5 levels:

=== Level 0 ===
''To achieve this level, parasites do not require any infected dimensions, nor points.''

=== Level 1 ===
''To achieve this level, parasites must have infected at least one dimension and 4 phases accumulated across all dimensions.''
* [[Dislodgment]] is unlocked.
* [[Moving Flesh|Parasite Merging]] is unlocked.

=== Level 2 ===
''To achieve this level, parasites must have infected at least two dimensions and 7 phases accumulated across all dimensions.''
* [[Primitive Parasites]] and [[Thrall|Thralls]] can now spawn naturally.
* [[Collective Consciousness]] is unlocked.
* The [[Scent System]] is unlocked.
* Parasites will now be able to spawn outside of [[Emerging Infestation Vector|Emerging Infestation Vectors]]. 

=== Level 3 ===
''To achieve this level, parasites must have infected at least two dimensions and 10 phases accumulated across all dimensions.''
* [[Adapted Parasites]] can now spawn naturally.
* [[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatchers]] and [[Rooter (Disambiguation)|Rooters]] will be able to spawn naturally, ignoring their respective conventional spawning methods.
* [[:Category:Variants|Variants]] will be more common.

=== Level 4 ===
''To achieve this level, parasites must have infected at least two dimensions and 14 phases accumulated across all dimensions.''
* [[Pure Parasites]], excluding [[Light Bomber|Light Bombers]], can now spawn naturally.
* [[Colony|Colonies]] are unlocked.
* [[Hive|Hives]] are unlocked.
* [[Parasite Biome|Nodes]] are unlocked.
* Primitive Parasites and Thralls will no longer spawn naturally.
